title: Intelligent Pot
subtitle: IoT and MQTT
description: An IoT planter built on an ESP32-S3 that samples five environmental sensors — soil moisture, temperature, humidity, ambient light, and air quality — and publishes telemetry over TLS-secured MQTT to a HiveMQ Cloud broker. A retained state topic lets a client connecting late immediately receive the device's current configuration, and a command topic closes the control loop, letting the dashboard trigger irrigation and configure lighting and audio remotely.

title: Runpath
subtitle: Backend & Cloud Architecture
description: A microservices backend built around an Express.js API gateway and an Nginx reverse proxy, with a FastAPI and Firebase authentication service. Internal service-to-service traffic is secured with self-signed certificates, and the containerized services were deployed as Pods on Google Cloud Platform.

title: Mascotas Bogotá
subtitle: Core Backend Development
description: The core REST API for a community-driven pet-tracking platform, handling CRUD operations for user publications. I designed the MongoDB schemas for location-based data and user reports, and built an observability pipeline with Prometheus and Grafana for real-time application health and performance metrics.

title: Brain Tumor MRI Classification
subtitle: Deep Learning & Computer Vision
description: A 3-person project benchmarking a custom PyTorch CNN against EfficientNetB0–B4 transfer-learning models to sort 5,700+ brain MRI scans into four categories: glioma, meningioma, pituitary, and no tumor. The tuned EfficientNetB3 reached 100% validation accuracy — 28 points above a zero-shot Gemini baseline.
